description: Runs one Wafermap resource and pays its exact USD price over x402, in USDG on Robinhood Chain or USDC on Solana, Base, Arbitrum or Polygon. Send a signed x402 v2 PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]; without it the tool returns isError with the payment requirements (price, networks, payTo) to sign. The work runs before the payment settles, so failed calls are never charged; a successful call returns the result plus a receipt with the transaction hash in _meta["x402/payment-response"]. Agents without an x402 wallet can use the Wafermap CLI (`wafermap mcp`), which pays automatically within spending caps.

input.description: Input object matching the resource's schema from wafermap_resource_schema, e.g. {"network":"base"}.

payer.description: Optional: the EVM wallet that will sign the payment. A wallet holding 100,000 $WAFERMAP on Robinhood Chain is quoted 50% less for Wafermap's own resources (checked again against the signer).

name: wafermap_call
title: Run a paid resource (x402)
